description: This file contains a serializer class for the RepeatedField<T> type, used in the Orleans.Serialization framework to handle serialization and deserialization of repeated fields containing elements of type T, leveraging Protobuf wire protocol.

classes.name: RepeatedFieldCodec<T>
classes.description: A sealed serializer class for handling serialization and deserialization of RepeatedField<T> within Orleans.Serialization framework.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a RepeatedField<T> instance, writing its contents to the provided writer using a specified field ID delta and expected type.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes data from a reader to reconstruct a RepeatedField<T> instance, handling reference tracking and wire format, based on the incoming serialized data.
